Name: Briefing_01
Speaker: System
Text: DEPARTMENT OF CONTINUITY - OPERATION 1888

Name: Briefing_02
Speaker: System
Text: Locate the subject known as Jack.

Name: Briefing_03
Speaker: System
Text: Prevent the crowd from capturing him.

Name: Briefing_04
Speaker: System
Text: Ensure that his identity remains unknown.

Name: Briefing_05
Speaker: System
Text: Any deviation will be corrected.

Name: JackFound_01
Speaker: Jack
Text: Are you looking for me too?

Name: JackFound_02
Speaker: Agent
Text: I'm here to get you out.

Name: JackFound_03
Speaker: Jack
Text: Then tell me this: if everyone thinks I'm a monster, why is someone keeping me alive?

Name: FutureMessage_01
Speaker: FutureSelf
Text: Do not confuse the orders you received with the facts you witnessed.

Name: Truth_01
Speaker: Supervisor
Text: I see the subject is still alive. Excellent.

Name: Truth_02
Speaker: Agent
Text: I found evidence that he did not commit the murders.

Name: Truth_03
Speaker: Supervisor
Text: We never asked you to find the culprit.

Name: Truth_04
Speaker: Agent
Text: Then what are we doing here?

Name: Truth_05
Speaker: Supervisor
Text: Giving the world one. Jack stays alive until the false case is ready. Then he disappears. His identity stays secret.

Name: Correction_Order
Speaker: System
Text: The agent has accessed unauthorized material. Initiate the correction protocol.

Name: SupervisorEncounter_01
Speaker: Supervisor
Text: You have made a mistake. Your job was to preserve history.

Name: SupervisorEncounter_02
Speaker: Agent
Text: Preserve it? We're framing an innocent man as Jack the Ripper.

Name: SupervisorEncounter_03
Speaker: Supervisor
Text: The Director decided which story would survive.

Name: SupervisorEncounter_04
Speaker: Agent
Text: Then he doesn't get the last word.

Name: EndingOfficial_01
Speaker: System
Text: Facts are fleeting. History endures.

Name: EndingAuthentic_01
Speaker: FutureSelf
Text: If you are reading this, they have already tried to erase the truth. This is not the first time.

Name: EndingAuthentic_02
Speaker: FutureSelf
Text: They can erase my memories. Not what happened.

Name: ContinuityAltered_01
Speaker: System
Text: CONTINUITY ALTERED - Action outside the official procedure.

Name: CombatWarning_01
Speaker: System
Text: Agent, your actions exceed the permitted parameters. You are altering continuity.
